customer.value: Digital Dubai Government Establishment, affiliated with Dubai Digital Authority

renewal.value: Customer must notify supplier in writing of intention to renew thirty (30) days before expiry. No unconditional automatic renewal is specified.

contracts.status_evidence: Countersigned PDF. Status of actual service completion, invoice issuance, payment and guarantee provision is not established by the contract alone.

bank_guarantee.value: Final, unconditional, irrevocable guarantee from bank operating within the State, for 10% of total contract value; starts on contract start date and remains valid for 90 days after contract end; revocation requires customer consent.

price_basis.value: Final fixed total includes all expenses and excludes VAT and applicable statutory fees; no unilateral price increase.

delay_or_failure_rule.value: Failure to provide contracted services/materials or delay beyond granted time permits measures under Dubai Law No. 12 of 2020 and relevant laws. Clause 12.16 repeats statutory penalties/fines/measures for delayed execution.

exemption.value: Supplier may seek exemption with supporting proof for emergency, force majeure, customer-caused delay or another cause outside its control. Exemption is effective only after customer consent under its legal procedures.

penalties.import_guidance: Do not invent a numeric penalty rate, daily formula, service credit or cap from the statutory reference. Store the statutory rule and exemption condition as text unless a separately verified instrument supplies a formula.

liability.value: Direct loss/damage indemnity; indirect loss, consequential damage and loss of profit excluded, except damage from gross negligence, fraud or confidentiality breach. The paragraph states compensation shall not exceed 100% of total contract value. Supplier remains responsible for subcontractor performance.
liability.note: This is a compensation/liability cap, not a delay-penalty cap.

breach_cure.value: Customer may terminate for an unrectified breach after written notification and fifteen (15) working days; supplier liable for customer termination costs.

convenience_notice.value: Customer may terminate early on at least thirty (30) days written notice; customer compensates value of supplied materials/services rendered.

other_grounds.value: Fraud/manipulation, bribery conviction, insolvency/bankruptcy/liquidation preventing performance, supplier replacement or inability to perform; customer may call performance security, enforce at supplier expense and seek damages.

force_majeure.value: Written notice within seven working days, with event details, supporting documents and mitigation; agreed timeline extension; resume performance when feasible; proven force-majeure delay relief and termination if performance becomes unfeasible.

disputes.value: Attempt amicable settlement; after thirty days without settlement refer to senior management of both parties. Dubai law and applicable UAE federal law govern; Dubai Courts for disagreement.

notices.value: In person, registered mail, email or other mutually agreed means; notify representative changes by email.

administration_and_security.value: Changes require mutual written agreement signed by authorized representatives through an approved addendum; contract terms prevail over discrepant appendices.
Prior IP remains with each party; use/licensing/transfer and use of names/logos need written consent or a separate written agreement. Customer materials/data create no supplier IP entitlement.

Confidentiality, return of customer confidential materials and security requirements survive expiry/termination. Apply proportionate ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 22301, ISR/DESC including applicable cloud standards; PCI DSS where payment data is involved.
Written customer consent required for subcontracting and assignment; supplier remains liable for subcontractor performance.
Customer preapproval for nominated specialists; qualified replacements, requested meetings, accurate performance records and compliance with written customer directions.
HSE compliance and precautions at customer premises; notify customer promptly if supplier personnel who attended premises contract an epidemic; maintain service continuity.
Customer may offset sums due and request statements/reports/records for audit. In a discrepancy between Arabic and English versions, Arabic prevails.
Customer returns performance security after an approved contract completion certificate; actual certificate or security return is not evidenced.

scope.value: Remote diagnostics/support through secure connection; telephone/email during operational hours; on-site visits when remote resolution is unavailable; repair/replacement of faulty equipment; corrective maintenance restoring normal operation; preventive inspections/upkeep per manufacturer recommendations.

customer_responsibilities.value: Provide remote access, site safety, necessary documentation and initial spare-parts inventory for corrective actions.

exclusions.value: Vandalism, disaster recovery, consumables and non-standard hardware/software changes not mutually agreed.

escalation.value: Escalation procedures apply when resolution exceeds agreed timelines; no numeric resolution limits or named escalation chain provided in this PDF.

delivery_milestones.value: Recurring maintenance throughout 1 January–31 December 2026; no separately dated delivery milestones beyond monthly service/invoicing and service-completion evidence.
